steps.text: I’m checking the order details to confirm its status, warehouse, line items, and promised date so I can choose the right next checks.
I’m checking on-hand and available stock for SKU-404 at WH-ATL to see if insufficient inventory is blocking fulfillment.
I’m searching other warehouses for at least 22 units of SKU-404 to see if a single-location transfer can resolve the shortfall.

arguments.summary: ORD-1002 has not been fulfilled because the assigned warehouse (WH-ATL) does not have enough available stock of SKU-404 (8 available vs 30 ordered), leaving a shortfall of 22 units. No single alternate warehouse can cover the entire shortfall for a transfer.
evidence: get_order_details: ORD-1002 fulfillment_status PENDING_FULFILLMENT at WH-ATL, promised_delivery_date 2026-03-18 (is_past_promised_date false).
get_order_details: line item SKU-404 quantity 30 for Bluebird Labs.
check_inventory: SKU-404 at WH-ATL on_hand 10, reserved 2, available 8.
find_alternative_stock: SKU-404 required_quantity 22 excluding WH-ATL; WH-BOS available 8 (can_cover_required_quantity false), WH-CHI 6 (false), WH-DAL 5 (false); warehouses_with_sufficient_stock [].
arguments.likely_cause: Insufficient available stock of SKU-404 at WH-ATL (8 available vs 30 ordered), with no single alternate warehouse able to cover the 22-unit shortfall.
uncertainties: Replenishment ETA for SKU-404 at WH-ATL is not available in the provided data.
Customer acceptance of partial shipment is unknown.
arguments.recommendation: Expedite procurement or inbound replenishment of 22 units of SKU-404 to WH-ATL; in the meantime, if acceptable, ship the 8 available units now and notify the customer that the remaining 22 units will follow on backorder.
